description: Keep your sneakers and travel accessories protected, organized, and secured with our Canvas Shoe Bag. The sneaker bag easily holds a pair of shoes up to men’s size 13. The golf shoe bag features a vintage-styled, two-way main brass zipper with leather pulls for easy access and a denim liner for contrast. Ample Storage: These shoe travel bags come equipped with an inner zipper pouch that provides extra storage for small travel essentials and footwear accessories. The organizer pouch doubles as a foldable divider that protects your uniform dress shoes from scuffs, and folds down when not in use, allowing you to store other travel items and toiletries. The shoe duffle bag measures 14.5 inch x 8.75 inch x 5 inch. Multipurpose Utility: The travel storage bag features a leather accented canvas web carry handle for quick and easy handling that is great for traveling, business trips, golf outings, and sports. Whether you are heading out for a weekend getaway or on the way to the golf course, our Canvas Shoe Bags ensure your uniform shoes, sneakers, and dress oxfords are well protected. Top Grade Canvas: Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul, allowing the travel shoe bag to withstand outdoor adventures or frequent trips. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs. Staying on Your Toes: Designed with precision and built to withstand the harshest conditions, Rothco's collection of footwear and accessories combines durability, functionality, and unparalleled performance. From our Forced Entry Series which features our speedlace and waterproof technologies, to our V-Max Collection designed with lightweight running shoe soles, our diverse range of footwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts. With a rich heritage spanning over 7 decades, Rothco is the go-to brand for all things that keep you standing on your feet.
